name: policy-action-check
description: Compile a policy’s anchored terms into two files: a generator for writing actions as short codes, and a judge that says which terms a code violates, what is required next, and the smallest fix. Runs without a model at use time. History is optional post-build evaluation.

guard_mode.title: Guard tool calls
guard_mode.description: Check Claude's own tool calls against the bundle's tool map before they run: off, warn (ask you), or enforce (deny violations).

space_dir.title: Bundle folder
space_dir.description: Folder in your project where the generator/judge bundle is written.

policy_date.title: Judge as of date
policy_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD used to decide which rules are in effect. Empty means today.
